recommended_third_slot.use: Covers, thumbnails, illustrations, text-in-image and transparent assets up to 2K
recommended_third_slot.memory: bf16: 14.2 GB transformer + 17.5 GB text encoder + 1.35 GB VAE. On 24 GB cards stages are offloaded to system RAM (~40 GB needed).
recommended_third_slot.placement: Own Ampere+ GPU box with its own tunnel (deploy/image/Dockerfile). Not on the V100 chat box.
